left.title: Manual signals
points: You confirm each setup before risking capital
Reads context a fixed ruleset misses (news, sentiment)
Execution lags the alert — slippage on fast moves
Caps out at the hours you can actually watch the screen
left.verdict: Best while you're still learning the edge by hand.

right.title: Automated bot
points: Fires entries in under 10ms, no hesitation
Trades 24/5 across every session without fatigue
Backtested rules stay consistent under drawdown
Only as good as the strategy and risk caps you give it
right.verdict: Best once your rules are proven and worth scaling.
